comparison.objective: Remove a supported optical instrument from fitted packaging and place it on a service stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated support, extraction from close-fitting foam, transfer, placement, and insert cleanup.
comparison.success_condition: Instrument and inserts correctly placed with no excessive historical tilt or unsupported descent; exact thresholds are only partly stated in the body and no spec version is present.
comparison.reason: It tests damage-avoiding unpacking and continuous support, not adjustment of a retained rotary control or repeated impact validation.
